title: OpenAI v1 SDK: Completions → Chat Completions migration

changes.description: `openai.completions.create` is deprecated; migrate to `openai.chat.completions.create` with the chat message format.

fix.explain: Replace completions.create with chat.completions.create and restructure the prompt into messages: [{role:'user', content: prompt}].

changes.description: The `prompt` parameter on completions is replaced by the `messages` array on chat.completions.

fix.explain: Wrap the prompt text in [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }].

changes.description: OpenAI SDK v4+ is required for chat.completions; v3 is no longer supported.

fix.explain: Upgrade the openai package to ^4.0.0 and update import/initialization to `new OpenAI({ apiKey })`.
